title: Qi Yuan finally took a snack from my hand
body: Six weeks of sitting quietly on the floor and pretending not to care. Today she leaned in, sniffed, and took the whole piece of banana. Small victories.

title: Oliver has declared war on the phone charger
body: Third cable this month. He waits until I leave the room. I've started routing everything through the ceiling like a proper adversary.

title: The two of them, finally sharing a corner
body: For months they'd sit on opposite ends of the room. Tonight they groomed each other by the window. I didn't move for an hour.
